text:
maria-finance: NovaHealth flagged INV-9621: a 'surge' line for 36h during last week's cross-region failover. They say traffic was normal. Can we audit?
aj-sales: They were failed over when us-west degraded around 02:10 UTC.
maria-finance: The problem: billed as surge overage instead of using their reserved commit. That looks like attribution failure.
tony-ops: Ops notes: traffic routed to fallback nodepools np-fb-7 and np-fb-8; those nodes came up without the commit tag due to autoscaler race.
sam-accounting: Pulling metering rows now. If org_id matches and meter_key is unallocated, we can request reclassification.
elaine-cs: Customer already asked for a credit while we investigate.
maria-finance: Policy: platform-initiated failovers are eligible for reclassification; need ops confirmation and accounting evidence.
tony-ops: Confirmed automated failover; adding incident note. Will also file an engineering task to ensure tag propagation on fallback.
sam-accounting: Query result: ~498,120 token units billed to meter_key=unallocated between 2026-04-02T02:09Z and 2026-04-02T13:05Z. 95% of request metadata contains novahealth org id. I'll open BILL-6073.
metering-bot: BILL-6073 created for metering anomaly org=novahealth.
maria-finance: Recommended: provisional credit equal to surge line while accounting attempts reclassification. Approve?
aj-sales: Approve provisional credit. We'll state it's provisional pending reclassification.
elaine-cs: Notified customer: provisional credit issued, ETA 72 hours. They acknowledged.
sam-accounting: Submitted reclassification with meter evidence and request ids. Created provisional credit CM-1189 with 7-day expiry.
metering-bot: BILL-6073 status changed to in_progress by sam-accounting.
sam-accounting: Update 2345679650: reclassification succeeded. 492,600 token units reattributed to commit-7. CM-1189 voided and invoice updated. Reconciliation attached to BILL-6073.
maria-finance: Great. Capture invoice line ids, meter rows, nodepool ids and decision for audit. Closing finance loop and notifying customer.
aj-sales: Following up with customer on mitigation and contract note to prevent future surprises.
